subject: Scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — calendar options and attendee ask
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom@seastone.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T15:02:00Z
Subject: Scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — calendar options and attendee ask

Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a suggested next step: both teams agreed a focused 60–90 minute technical deep dive (ops + model-serving + integration) makes sense to validate performance assumptions and scope integration work.

What we need from you to lock the session:
- Confirm 2–3 people from Seastone who will join (engineer + ML lead preferred)
- Confirm any specific systems/access we should prep for (VPC, S3 endpoints, sample payloads)
- Pick one of the windows below (I tried to offer across timezones):

Proposed windows (PT):
1) Tue Jun 27 — 09:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed Jun 28 — 11:00–12:30 PT
3) Thu Jun 29 — 07:30–09:00 PT

Agenda (draft):
- 5m introductions + success criteria
- 25m infra topology & network/security requirements (Neha)
- 25m model/latency expectations + sample run (Ben + Grace)
- 20m integration path & action items (owners, test data, timelines)
- 5–15m Q&A and next steps

I attached a short post-call brief and a one-page agenda you can share with your team. If none of those windows work, send three options and we’ll prioritize.

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
seastone-postcall-brief.pdf (attachment)
From: Tom Baxter <tom@seastone.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Sofia Mendes <sofia@seastone.ai>, Rahul Iyer <rahul@seastone.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T01:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — calendar options and attendee ask

Ben — thanks for the recap, that looks good. We can do a 90-minute slot and would like to have two engineers there: Sofia (platform lead) and Rahul (ml infra). They prefer mornings PT.

All three proposed windows look like they could work on our side; our preference would be Tue Jun 27 09:00 PT or Wed Jun 28 11:00 PT.

Two asks from us before the session:
- Can you confirm whether the session will include a short live run with our sample payloads? If so, we can pre-stage a small dataset (S3 link).
- We need to make sure you cover VPC peering options and data residency — those are gating for our security review.

I'll hold space tentatively; please confirm which slot you pick and we’ll send calendar invites with attendee names.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Baxter | Head of Platform Engineering
Seastone AI
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Tom Baxter <tom@seastone.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — calendar options and attendee ask

Looping in operations/infra owners and proposing final confirmation.

Tom — great, thanks for the heads up on attendees. We can definitely do a short live run (15–20m) with a pre-staged S3 sample — please share the link or a sample payload spec and we’ll validate tokenization/seq lengths ahead of time. I’ll own the VPC/security section. Grace will lead the deployment/perf discussion and run the sample locally.

Internal owners and asks:
- Neha (me): VPC/peering, KMS, audit logging — will prepare network checklist and security preflight.
- Grace O'Connor: deployment flow, KV cache expectations, quantization impact — will prepare perf knobs and a short demo script.
- Ben Carter: commercial success criteria and rollout ask.

Ben — can you lock Tue Jun 27 09:00–10:30 PT? That works for our infra roster. If you prefer the later Wed slot, say so and we’ll reshuffle.

Neha Kapoor
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom@seastone.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T18:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Scheduling 60-90m ML/Infra deep dive — calendar options and attendee ask

Thanks all — locking Tue Jun 27 09:00–10:30 PT and sending the invite now. 

Tom: calendar invite + Zoom will be in your inbox, and I attached the v1 agenda (tdx-agenda-v1.docx) with the owner callouts. Please send the S3 sample or a short spec (file size, avg seq length) to tom@seastone.ai and cc me — we’ll validate the run.

Action items:
- Tom: confirm S3 sample/spec and attendee names in the invite (Sofia, Rahul confirmed)
- Neha: share VPC/network checklist by EOD Mon Jun 26
- Grace: share demo script + perf knobs by EOD Mon Jun 26
- Ben: create HubSpot activity and link invite (done)

Attachments: tdx-agenda-v1.docx
Calendar: https://redwood.app/calendar/ics/rdw-3452-tdx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-3452

See you on the 27th — Ben
